lines.text: Report to anyone listening... This is Kanta Fujimoto.
I’ve crash-landed on Inari. A barren, unforgiving rock adrift in the cosmos.
Icarus is battered beyond hope, and my only chance is to scavenge what I can from the wreckage.
Time to figure out how to survive, fight through the darkness... and maybe find a smoke.
This is Kanta Fujimoto, last survivor of the starship Icarus.
If I make it to the frontier, maybe this will all be worth it...
